state.intent: Add a current-only, terms-governed FINRA weekly off-exchange display for five ETFs
catalog: Existing OffExchangeActivity panel with outbound ETF links and separate MARKET quarterly venue tiles
MorningBoard light/dark panel/text/line/accent tokens, Manrope and Space Grotesk, 44px controls
Client-selected MARKET/SPY/QQQ/IWM/DIA/TLT and historical edition states
constraints: No FINRA raw/derived values in public Git, JSON APIs, downloads, saved editions or models
Server-only private snapshot; same-origin HTML POST view only after reader checkbox agrees to free noncommercial personal/professional use and no onward redistribution
Historical editions must omit the entire current FINRA component
ATS and non-ATS volume are delayed activity, never buying/selling intent or consensus votes
No private rows or credentials supplied to Jev; 10 observed weeks per instrument; fractional share quantities must be preserved
375px phone, desktop, keyboard, labelled responsive table, no animation needed
candidates: Latest week paired horizontal bars with ten-week table in a disclosure
Ten-week paired bars with latest totals above
Latest week paired cards with ten-week table

presentation.instructions: Choose a clear compact comparison inside the existing OffExchangeActivity panel; maintain source/date/units and a readable ten-week history.

criteria.latest_bars_table: Latest week paired horizontal volume bars, dated totals; ten-week accessible table below in a disclosure
criteria.ten_week_bars: Ten-week paired bar chart with latest totals above
criteria.latest_cards_table: Latest week two total cards plus ten-week accessible table
